push.title: Time to take attendance
push.body: {classes}: attendance hasn't been taken yet. Sunset is in about an hour and a half.

banner.title: Attendance not taken yet
banner.body: {classes}: please take today's attendance before sunset.

card.title: Attendance reminder
card.offDescription: Get a notification on this phone every day about an hour and a half before sunset (around {time} today) if you haven't taken attendance. Tap it to open the attendance page.
card.onDescription: Reminders are on for this phone. If attendance isn't taken, you'll be notified about an hour and a half before sunset (around {time} today). Nothing is sent on Sundays.
card.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then come back here.
card.unsupported: This browser can't show reminder notifications. The reminder still appears in the bell at the top.
card.needsInstall: On iPhone or iPad, first add this app to your Home Screen (Share, then “Add to Home Screen”), then open it from there to turn on reminders.
card.testBody: This is how the attendance reminder looks. Tap “Take attendance” to open the page.
card.failed: Couldn't change reminders. Please try again.

adminSms.title: Parents not texted
adminSms.body: {ustazes} did not text the parents of absent students.

adminCard.title: Notifications for this phone
adminCard.offDescription: Every evening at {time}, get a notification listing the Ustazes who didn't text the parents of absent students. Tap it to see who.
adminCard.onDescription: Notifications are on for this phone. Every evening at {time} you'll be told which Ustazes didn't text the parents of absent students.
adminCard.testBody: This is how the notification looks. Tap “See who” to open the list.
